title: Gilliganův ostrov: Ráj konspiračních teoretiků (S18E07)
title_en: Gilligan's Island: A Conspiracy Theorist's Paradise
plot: Mac a Charlie pátrají, pročGilliganův ostrovnikdy nedostal stý díl.(Disney+)

reviews.author: Devadesát Dva
reviews.text: "Good theory! All right, just stop drinking the Kool-Aid." "I only drank, like, a little bit of it, so..." "That’s not what I was talking about. I was talking about the metaphorical Kool-Aid. You happen to be drinking both." (...) "I knew it! Birds aren’t real, dude!" (...) "No, but you know what is white?" "The White House." "You know what else is white?" "Uh, probably, like, Madonna’s cars." "Yeah, we’re gonna get on the same page. I promise we’re gonna get on the same page at some point, yeah." "Baseballs." "Correct. And?" "Half a zebra..." "All of those are correct but not pertinent to what we’re talking about."(14.10.2026)

reviews.author: JamesSi
reviews.text: Co je sakra ve vodě? Tenhle rok jsme dostali parodickou epizodu na Gilligan's Island, jak od Futuramy, tak od Always Sunny, ale musím říct že Always Sunny verze je stokrát lepší a funguje i bez znalosti originálu.(25.09.2026)
